description: The file defines the TaskRepository class, which provides an API for data operations related to tasks in a to-do list application. It interacts with the TaskDao for database operations and includes functions to observe, add, update, delete, toggle completion status, and seed data into the database.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing an API for task data operations, interacting with TaskDao.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all Tasks from the database.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves a Task by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new Task with provided title, description, and optional due date.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates the provided Task in the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the specified Task from the database.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a Task.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds the database with sample Tasks if it is empty.
